comparison.objective: Place six model wind turbines across two plots so none lies in another's wake.
comparison.physical_skill: Interpret wind direction and arrange objects using anisotropic spacing rules; no force-sensitive tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Three turbines per plot avoid wakes using seven rotor diameters downwind and three across; partial credit is defined per plot.
comparison.reason: The record tests spatial planning from environmental semantics, not mechanical component processing.
